description.en: itemIndex starts at 1. The oldest item is 1. Returns rollID, itemLink, numPlayers, isDone, winnerIdx, isMasterLoot, isCurrency: - rollID — a stable ID for the roll. The itemIndex of an item changes when the history is full and drops its oldest item. The rollID does not change. Use it as the key for data about a row, for example "this row is expanded". - itemLink — item:<id>:0:<suffix>:<unique>. You can give it to GetItemInfo and GameTooltip:SetHyperlink. It has the random suffix of the item, so an "of the X" item keeps its suffix. - numPlayers — the number of players in the list for this item. - isDone — true when the item has a winner, or when all players passed. - winnerIdx — the player index of the winner, for C_LootHistory.GetPlayerInfo(itemIndex, winnerIdx). nil when the item has no winner yet, or when all players passed. The winner is always in the player list. - isMasterLoot — always false. - isCurrency — always false.

description.en: ClassicAPI extension. Returns every WorldMapOverlay.dbc entry for a zone — **explored or not** — with the tile grid fully resolved. description.en: Returns localizedClass, englishClass, localizedRace, englishRace, sex, name, realm, guid for a player, or nil if the name is not known. Use it when you have a player's name but not the GUID. For example, a system message names a player in its text, and its arg12 is "".

description.en: Returns the current state of the persistent name cache as a boolean. false until [SetEnabled](#c_playercachesetenabledenabled) has been called (or its prior call survived in the on-disk settings file).
description.de: (englisch) Returns the current state of the persistent name cache as a boolean. false until [SetEnabled](#c_playercachesetenabledenabled) has been called (or its prior call survived in the on-disk settings file).

description.en: Adds a (guid → name, classID, raceID, sex) entry to the persistent name cache. For the engine-driven coverage (chat / group / guild / visible objects), no addon-side feeding is needed — those flow into the cache automatically through the engine's SMSG_NAME_QUERY_RESPONSE write path. This call exists for the *other* sources libunitscan-style addons harvest from but the engine NameCache doesn't see directly: /who results, mouseover, target snapshots, etc.

description.en: Opts into (or out of) the persistent name cache. enabled is a boolean (numeric 0/1 also accepted). Persists to WTF\Account\<account>\ClassicAPI.txt as PersistentNameCacheEnabled=1/0, so the choice survives client restarts.
description.de: (englisch) Opts into (or out of) the persistent name cache. enabled is a boolean (numeric 0/1 also accepted). Persists to WTF\Account\<account>\ClassicAPI.txt as PersistentNameCacheEnabled=1/0, so the choice survives client restarts.

description.en: Returns localizedClass, englishClass, localizedRace, englishRace, sex, name, realm for a player GUID the engine has cached, or nil on a cache miss.
description.de: (englisch) Returns localizedClass, englishClass, localizedRace, englishRace, sex, name, realm for a player GUID the engine has cached, or nil on a cache miss.

description.en: Returns name, realm for the player identified by guid, or nil if no player with that GUID has been encountered yet.
description.de: (englisch) Returns name, realm for the player identified by guid, or nil if no player with that GUID has been encountered yet.

description.en: Clears every new flag at once. Fires BAG_NEW_ITEMS_UPDATED if anything was flagged.
description.de: (englisch) Clears every new flag at once. Fires BAG_NEW_ITEMS_UPDATED if anything was flagged.

description.en: Returns true if the item currently in bag bagID slot slotIndex is flagged new, false otherwise (empty slot, unflagged item, or non-numeric args). bagID 0 is the backpack; 1–4 are the equipped bags. Slot indices are 1-based, matching GetContainerItemInfo.
description.de: (englisch) Returns true if the item currently in bag bagID slot slotIndex is flagged new, false otherwise (empty slot, unflagged item, or non-numeric args). bagID 0 is the backpack; 1–4 are the equipped bags. Slot indices are 1-based, matching GetContainerItemInfo.

description.en: Clears the new flag for the item in that slot, for example after the player sees the item. No-op if the slot is empty or the item wasn't flagged. Fires BAG_NEW_ITEMS_UPDATED when it actually removes a flag. Because the flag is GUID-keyed, the item stays un-flagged even if it's later moved to another slot.
description.de: (englisch) Clears the new flag for the item in that slot, for example after the player sees the item. No-op if the slot is empty or the item wasn't flagged. Fires BAG_NEW_ITEMS_UPDATED when it actually removes a flag. Because the flag is GUID-keyed, the item stays un-flagged even if it's later moved to another slot.

description.en: Type checks on the raw 1.12 GUID format. GUIDs encode the entity type in the high 16 bits of the qword — players have 0x0000 (low dword = player ID), creatures 0xF130xxxx, pets 0xF140xxxx, game objects (herbs / chests / etc.) 0xF110xxxx, items 0x4000xxxx. Each function returns true only for its specific prefix; the "0x0000000000000000" sentinel returns false from all four.

description.en: GetAddOnCPUUsage returns the time in milliseconds that an addon's functions ran. The value comes from the last call to UpdateAddOnCPUUsage. The time of each function counts once, for the addon that made the function.
description.de: (englisch) GetAddOnCPUUsage returns the time in milliseconds that an addon's functions ran. The value comes from the last call to UpdateAddOnCPUUsage. The time of each function counts once, for the addon that made the function.

description.en: GetAddOnMemoryUsage returns the Lua memory that an addon uses, in kilobytes. The value comes from the last call to UpdateAddOnMemoryUsage. Call UpdateAddOnMemoryUsage first. Each call counts all memory again, so do not call it every frame.
description.de: (englisch) GetAddOnMemoryUsage returns the Lua memory that an addon uses, in kilobytes. The value comes from the last call to UpdateAddOnMemoryUsage. Call UpdateAddOnMemoryUsage first. Each call counts all memory again, so do not call it every frame.

description.en: Returns two values: the time in milliseconds that event handlers ran, and the number of events that fired. The values are for all events. The event argument has no effect.
description.de: (englisch) Returns two values: the time in milliseconds that event handlers ran, and the number of events that fired. The values are for all events. The event argument has no effect.

description.en: Returns two values: the time in milliseconds that the frame's scripts ran, and the number of calls to them. Each script counts, OnUpdate included. If includeChildren is true (the default), the values include the child frames of the frame.
description.de: (englisch) Returns two values: the time in milliseconds that the frame's scripts ran, and the number of calls to them. Each script counts, OnUpdate included. If includeChildren is true (the default), the values include the child frames of the frame.

description.en: Returns two values: the time in milliseconds that the function ran, and the number of calls to it. If includeSubroutines is true (the default), the time includes the functions that it calls. If includeSubroutines is false, the time is only the function's own code.
description.de: (englisch) Returns two values: the time in milliseconds that the function ran, and the number of calls to it. If includeSubroutines is true (the default), the time includes the functions that it calls. If includeSubroutines is false, the time is only the function's own code.

description.en: Returns the time in milliseconds that all frame scripts ran. When a script runs inside a different script, the time counts for both scripts.
description.de: (englisch) Returns the time in milliseconds that all frame scripts ran. When a script runs inside a different script, the time counts for both scripts.

description.en: Sets all CPU times and call counts to 0, and the event count too. Memory values do not change.

description.en: Returns a QuestInfo table for one row of the quest log, or nil if the index is not a row of the log. The index counts headers, the same as GetQuestLogTitle(index).
description.de: (englisch) Returns a QuestInfo table for one row of the quest log, or nil if the index is not a row of the log. The index counts headers, the same as GetQuestLogTitle(index).

description.en: The quest's objective count — exactly the length GetQuestDetails(questID).requirements would have — read straight from the quest cache with **no Lua tables or strings materialized**. Returns nil when the quest isn't cached (same contract as GetQuestDetails).
description.de: (englisch) The quest's objective count — exactly the length GetQuestDetails(questID).requirements would have — read straight from the quest cache with **no Lua tables or strings materialized**. Returns nil when the quest isn't cached (same contract as GetQuestDetails).

description.en: Returns a table with every field we know how to read from the engine's quest static-info cache for questID, or nil if the data isn't loaded. One round-trip alternative to calling GetTitleForQuestID / GetQuestLogRewardMoney / etc. across each of its individual accessors. Quest-helper-style addons that want structured data per quest are the primary consumers.
description.de: (englisch) Returns a table with every field we know how to read from the engine's quest static-info cache for questID, or nil if the data isn't loaded. One round-trip alternative to calling GetTitleForQuestID / GetQuestLogRewardMoney / etc. across each of its individual accessors. Quest-helper-style addons that want structured data per quest are the primary consumers.

description.en: ClassicAPI function (Quest). Signature not documented yet.
description.de: ClassicAPI-Funktion (Quest). Signatur noch nicht dokumentiert.

description.en: Returns the 1-based log index of the collapsible **header** (zone / "Dungeon" / class-sort category, …) that questID sits under, or nil if the quest isn't in the log. The quest log is laid out header-then-its-quests, so this locates the quest and walks back to the nearest preceding header row. Pass the result to GetQuestLogTitle(headerIndex) for the category name.
description.de: (englisch) Returns the 1-based log index of the collapsible **header** (zone / "Dungeon" / class-sort category, …) that questID sits under, or nil if the quest isn't in the log. The quest log is laid out header-then-its-quests, so this locates the quest and walks back to the nearest preceding header row. Pass the result to GetQuestLogTitle(headerIndex) for the category name.

description.en: The inverse of GetQuestIDForLogIndex: returns the 1-based quest log index of questID, or nil if the quest isn't in the log. The index spans the full entry list (headers included), so it can be passed straight to GetQuestLogTitle(index) / GetQuestLogLeaderBoardID(...) and the other index-based quest-log accessors.
description.de: (englisch) The inverse of GetQuestIDForLogIndex: returns the 1-based quest log index of questID, or nil if the quest isn't in the log. The index spans the full entry list (headers included), so it can be passed straight to GetQuestLogTitle(index) / GetQuestLogLeaderBoardID(...) and the other index-based quest-log accessors.

description.en: Returns the questID (Quest.dbc row ID) for the entry at the given 1-based quest log index. The stock GetQuestLogTitle doesn't return it, even though the engine has it internally.
description.de: (englisch) Returns the questID (Quest.dbc row ID) for the entry at the given 1-based quest log index. The stock GetQuestLogTitle doesn't return it, even though the engine has it internally.

description.en: Returns the title (string) for questID from the engine's quest static-info cache, or nil if the data isn't loaded. Doesn't require the quest to be in the player's quest log — works for any questID once its data has been fetched. Header rows are excluded (their titles live in QuestSort.dbc, not in this cache); for those you'd use the existing GetQuestLogTitle.

Header rows are excluded (their titles live in QuestSort.dbc, not in this cache); for those you'd use the existing GetQuestLogTitle.

description.en: Returns whether the player has the quest.
description.de: Gibt zurück, ob der Spieler die Quest hat.

description.en: Returns true if the quest's static data is currently in the client-side quest cache, false otherwise. Pure cache probe — no server query, no side effects. Pair with C_QuestLog.RequestLoadQuestByID when you need to ensure the data is loaded before checking.
description.de: (englisch) Returns true if the quest's static data is currently in the client-side quest cache, false otherwise. Pure cache probe — no server query, no side effects. Pair with C_QuestLog.RequestLoadQuestByID when you need to ensure the data is loaded before checking.

description.en: Returns true if the unit has questID in their quest list. Arg order is unit first, questID second — and questID-keyed rather than log-index-keyed like the stock IsUnitOnQuest(logIndex, unit).
description.de: (englisch) Returns true if the unit has questID in their quest list. Arg order is unit first, questID second — and questID-keyed rather than log-index-keyed like the stock IsUnitOnQuest(logIndex, unit).

description.en: Asks the engine to fetch the static data for questID (title, description, objectives, reward text) from the server if not already cached. Returns no values — fire-and-forget.
description.de: (englisch) Asks the engine to fetch the static data for questID (title, description, objectives, reward text) from the server if not already cached. Returns no values — fire-and-forget.

description.en: Turtle WoW only (see [Completed quests](#completed-quests)). Returns an array of the completed quest IDs, from the lowest ID to the highest.
description.de: (englisch) Turtle WoW only (see [Completed quests](#completed-quests)). Returns an array of the completed quest IDs, from the lowest ID to the highest.

description.en: Returns whether a quest was completed (Turtle WoW).
description.de: Gibt zurück, ob eine Quest abgeschlossen wurde (Turtle WoW).

description.en: Returns the text that the quest log shows when a quest is ready to turn in. The text is the quest objectives. Tokens such as $N (player name) and $C (class) are replaced, as in the quest log.
description.de: (englisch) Returns the text that the quest log shows when a quest is ready to turn in. The text is the quest objectives. Tokens such as $N (player name) and $C (class) are replaced, as in the quest log.

description.en: Companion to the stock GetQuestLogLeaderBoard — returns (id, kind) for the same objective the existing call formats text for. id is always positive (the raw RequiredNPCOrGo field is signed, but the sign is folded into kind instead); kind is one of "monster", "object", or "item". Returns nothing for: out-of-range objectiveIndex, header rows, quests whose static data hasn't been cached yet, or event-text-only objectives that have no entry ID.
description.de: (englisch) Companion to the stock GetQuestLogLeaderBoard — returns (id, kind) for the same objective the existing call formats text for. id is always positive (the raw RequiredNPCOrGo field is signed, but the sign is folded into kind instead); kind is one of "monster", "object", or "item". Returns nothing for: out-of-range objectiveIndex, header rows, quests whose static data hasn't been cached yet, or event-text-only objectives that have no entry ID.

description.en: Turtle WoW only (see [Completed quests](#completed-quests)). Returns a table in which the key of each completed quest is its quest ID and the value is true.
description.de: (englisch) Turtle WoW only (see [Completed quests](#completed-quests)). Returns a table in which the key of each completed quest is its quest ID and the value is true.

description.en: Turtle WoW only (see [Completed quests](#completed-quests)). Sends a request for the list of completed quests to the server, and returns at once. When the list arrives, QUEST_QUERY_COMPLETE fires.
description.de: (englisch) Turtle WoW only (see [Completed quests](#completed-quests)). Sends a request for the list of completed quests to the server, and returns at once. When the list arrives, QUEST_QUERY_COMPLETE fires.

description.en: Returns the files that played most recently, newest first. Use it to find the path of a sound you just heard.
description.de: (englisch) Returns the files that played most recently, newest first. Use it to find the path of a sound you just heard.

description.en: Returns the volume a sound is playing at — its own volume after any scaling. Returns nil once the sound has ended.
description.de: (englisch) Returns the volume a sound is playing at — its own volume after any scaling. Returns nil once the sound has ended.

description.en: Returns true while the sound for that handle is still playing.
description.de: (englisch) Returns true while the sound for that handle is still playing.

description.en: Plays the noise an item makes when you handle it, without doing the action.
description.de: (englisch) Plays the noise an item makes when you handle it, without doing the action.

description.en: Plays a SoundKitID, and takes only a number. Returns willPlay, soundHandle.

description.de: (englisch) The same as C_Sound.PlaySound, with the arguments in a table. Returns success, soundHandle.

description.de: (englisch) Cancel a buff on the player by spellID or by spell name. Both are player-only (the server only accepts CMSG_CANCEL_AURA for the local player's own auras).

description.de: (englisch) Casts a spell **at unit, whatever its target type** — ClassicAPI's analog of /cast [@unit] Spell:

description.de: (englisch) Returns the unit's in-progress **regular cast** (not a channel), or nil if it isn't casting. C_Spell.CastingInfo() is C_Spell.UnitCastingInfo("player") without the unit-token lookup.

description.de: (englisch) Returns the unit's in-progress **channel**, or nil if it isn't channeling. C_Spell.ChannelInfo() is C_Spell.UnitChannelInfo("player") without the token lookup. description.en: Returns true if spellID resolves to a populated Spell.dbc record, false otherwise. Cheap pre-flight check for any of the spellID-keyed C_Spell.* calls — if this returns false, the rest of the family will return nil/empty.

description.en: Returns the localized name for a damage-school bitmask. Resolves single-bit masks via the engine's SPELL_SCHOOL<n>_CAP global strings (SPELL_SCHOOL0_CAP = "Physical", SPELL_SCHOOL2_CAP = "Fire", etc.).
description.de: (englisch) Returns the localized name for a damage-school bitmask. Resolves single-bit masks via the engine's SPELL_SCHOOL<n>_CAP global strings (SPELL_SCHOOL0_CAP = "Physical", SPELL_SCHOOL2_CAP = "Fire", etc.).

description.en: Returns how many times the player can cast the spell with the reagents they carry. Returns 0 for a spell without reagents, and for an unknown spell.
description.de: (englisch) Returns how many times the player can cast the spell with the reagents they carry. Returns 0 for a spell without reagents, and for an unknown spell.

description.en: Returns a SpellCooldownInfo table for the given spell, or nil if the identifier doesn't resolve to a Spell.dbc row. Table-shape variant of the stock GetSpellCooldown(slot, bookType) — accepts a spellID directly without forcing the caller to resolve a spellbook slot first.
description.de: (englisch) Returns a SpellCooldownInfo table for the given spell, or nil if the identifier doesn't resolve to a Spell.dbc row. Table-shape variant of the stock GetSpellCooldown(slot, bookType) — accepts a spellID directly without forcing the caller to resolve a spellbook slot first.

description.en: Returns the formatted spell description for any spellID — including spells the player has not learned. $s1/$s2/$o1/$d-style placeholders are resolved to base-rank values; ranges and durations appear as actual numbers (e.g. "14 to 22 Fire damage", not "$s1 to $s2 Fire damage"). Returns nil if the spell ID is out of range or has no description in the current locale.
description.de: (englisch) Returns the formatted spell description for any spellID — including spells the player has not learned. $s1/$s2/$o1/$d-style placeholders are resolved to base-rank values; ranges and durations appear as actual numbers (e.g. "14 to 22 Fire damage", not "$s1 to $s2 Fire damage"). Returns nil if the spell ID is out of range or has no description in the current locale.

description.en: Returns the spell's dispel type from Spell.dbc: 1 = Magic, 2 = Curse, 3 = Disease, 4 = Poison. Returns 0 for a spell that nothing can dispel, and for an unknown spell.
description.de: (englisch) Returns the spell's dispel type from Spell.dbc: 1 = Magic, 2 = Curse, 3 = Disease, 4 = Poison. Returns 0 for a spell that nothing can dispel, and for an unknown spell.

description.en: Returns one table per spell effect, holding that effect's raw Spell.dbc fields, as a 1-based array of three. nil for an invalid or out-of-range spell ID.
description.de: (englisch) Returns one table per spell effect, holding that effect's raw Spell.dbc fields, as a 1-based array of three. nil for an invalid or out-of-range spell ID.

description.en: Returns the spell's three per-effect SpellMechanic ids (Spell.dbc EffectMechanic[3]) as a 1-based array table, or nil for an invalid / out-of-range spell ID. description.de: (englisch) Returns true while a logout or quit countdown runs, false otherwise. Takes no arguments.

description.en: Returns whether the player is mounted.
description.de: Gibt zurück, ob der Spieler beritten ist.

description.en: Returns whether the player is outdoors.
description.de: Gibt zurück, ob der Spieler draußen ist.

description.en: Returns true when the player is in the world, false during a loading screen. Takes no arguments.
description.de: (englisch) Returns true when the player is in the world, false during a loading screen. Takes no arguments.

description.en: Returns whether the player is stealthed.
description.de: Gibt zurück, ob der Spieler getarnt ist.

description.en: Returns whether the player is swimming.
description.de: Gibt zurück, ob der Spieler schwimmt.

description.en: Turns [PLAYER_SWING_RANGE_UPDATE](#player_swing_range_update-event) on or off for one swing type.
description.de: (englisch) Turns [PLAYER_SWING_RANGE_UPDATE](#player_swing_range_update-event) on or off for one swing type.

description.en: Returns whether your current target is in range for a swing type (an [Enum.PlayerSwingType](#enumplayerswingtype) value).
description.de: (englisch) Returns whether your current target is in range for a swing type (an [Enum.PlayerSwingType](#enumplayerswingtype) value).

description.en: Copies text to the clipboard.
description.de: Kopiert Text in die Zwischenablage.

description.en: Flashes the client's taskbar button to get the player's attention (a retail backport). Does nothing while WoW is the foreground window, and returns nothing.
description.de: (englisch) Flashes the client's taskbar button to get the player's attention (a retail backport). Does nothing while WoW is the foreground window, and returns nothing.

description.en: Returns (widthPixels, heightPixels): the size of the game window in pixels. In a window, this is the size of the window, and it changes when you resize the window. PixelUtil uses this function to convert pixels to UI units (768.0 / physicalHeight). With this conversion, addons can put frames on whole pixels, so borders stay sharp at all UI scales.
description.de: (englisch) Returns (widthPixels, heightPixels): the size of the game window in pixels. In a window, this is the size of the window, and it changes when you resize the window. PixelUtil uses this function to convert pixels to UI units (768.0 / physicalHeight). With this conversion, addons can put frames on whole pixels, so borders stay sharp at all UI scales.

description.en: Returns the engine's hidden talentID — the primary key of the Talent.dbc row — for the talent at the given (tab, idx). Returns nil for out-of-range indices.
description.de: (englisch) Returns the engine's hidden talentID — the primary key of the Talent.dbc row — for the talent at the given (tab, idx). Returns nil for out-of-range indices.

description.en: Returns the spellID for the talent at the given (tabIndex, talentIndex) and rank, or nil if the talent index is out of range or the rank slot is empty. 1.12's GetTalentInfo returns (name, icon, tier, column, currentRank, maxRank, ...) with no spellID; this fills the gap so addons can chain into the spell APIs without maintaining their own (class, tab, idx) → spellID lookup tables.
description.de: (englisch) Returns the spellID for the talent at the given (tabIndex, talentIndex) and rank, or nil if the talent index is out of range or the rank slot is empty. 1.12's GetTalentInfo returns (name, icon, tier, column, currentRank, maxRank, ...) with no spellID; this fills the gap so addons can chain into the spell APIs without maintaining their own (class, tab, idx) → spellID lookup tables.

description.en: Returns the facing of the player in radians.
description.de: Gibt die Blickrichtung des Spielers im Bogenmaß zurück.

description.en: Targets the enemy in a direction on the screen. Use it for keys or a gamepad stick that move the target left, right, up or down.
description.de: (englisch) Targets the enemy in a direction on the screen. Use it for keys or a gamepad stick that move the target left, right, up or down.

description.en: Same as TargetDirectionEnemy, but for friendly units that you can assist.
description.de: (englisch) Same as TargetDirectionEnemy, but for friendly units that you can assist.

description.en: Ends the lock from TargetDirectionEnemy or TargetDirectionFriend, so the next call can select a target again.
description.de: (englisch) Ends the lock from TargetDirectionEnemy or TargetDirectionFriend, so the next call can select a target again.

description.en: Cycles through the nearest units, of any kind. It works like TargetNearestEnemy:
description.de: (englisch) Cycles through the nearest units, of any kind. It works like TargetNearestEnemy:

description.en: Like TargetNearest, but only enemy **players**.
description.de: (englisch) Like TargetNearest, but only enemy **players**.

description.en: Like TargetNearest, but only friendly **players** that you can assist.
description.de: (englisch) Like TargetNearest, but only friendly **players** that you can assist.

description.en: Targets a unit or object and interacts with it. The result is the same as a right-click on it in the world. For example, it opens a vendor, loots a corpse, or opens a mailbox.
description.de: (englisch) Targets a unit or object and interacts with it. The result is the same as a right-click on it in the world. For example, it opens a vendor, loots a corpse, or opens a mailbox.

description.en: Does the same as [InteractUnit](#interactunitunit--exactmatch), but returns a boolean.
description.de: (englisch) Does the same as [InteractUnit](#interactunitunit--exactmatch), but returns a boolean.

description.en: Returns true when your target is loose, and false when it is locked. See [Soft enemy and soft friend](#soft-enemy-and-soft-friend-softenemy--softfriend--anyenemy--anyfriend).
description.de: (englisch) Returns true when your target is loose, and false when it is locked. See [Soft enemy and soft friend](#soft-enemy-and-soft-friend-softenemy--softfriend--anyenemy--anyfriend).

description.en: Returns an array of flight masters. A numeric mapID (a Map.dbc id — 0 Eastern Kingdoms, 1 Kalimdor, 30 Alterac Valley, … — the same identity C_Map.GetAreaTriggers([mapID]) uses) filters to that continent. **Omitted / non-number returns every flight master on every continent** — a one-call flight database (each entry carries its own mapID). This is a ClassicAPI extension to the required-argument signature.
description.de: (englisch) Returns an array of flight masters. A numeric mapID (a Map.dbc id — 0 Eastern Kingdoms, 1 Kalimdor, 30 Alterac Valley, … — the same identity C_Map.GetAreaTriggers([mapID]) uses) filters to that continent. **Omitted / non-number returns every flight master on every continent** — a one-call flight database (each entry carries its own mapID). This is a ClassicAPI extension to the required-argument signature.

description.en: Returns the live flight-master destination list — the nodes reachable from the **currently open** taxi map, with reachability state and the slot index needed to take the flight. **Only meaningful while the taxi map is open** (between TAXIMAP_OPENED and TAXIMAP_CLOSED); returns an empty table otherwise. uiMapID is accepted for signature parity but ignored (there is a single active taxi map).
description.de: (englisch) Returns the live flight-master destination list — the nodes reachable from the **currently open** taxi map, with reachability state and the slot index needed to take the flight. **Only meaningful while the taxi map is open** (between TAXIMAP_OPENED and TAXIMAP_CLOSED); returns an empty table otherwise. uiMapID is accepted for signature parity but ignored (there is a single active taxi map).

description.en: Returns every flight path (directed edge) in TaxiPath.dbc as an array of tables — the taxi routing graph. No flight master needed; reads the DBC directly.
description.de: (englisch) Returns every flight path (directed edge) in TaxiPath.dbc as an array of tables — the taxi routing graph. No flight master needed; reads the DBC directly.

description.en: Returns the waypoint polyline of one flight path as an array of world coordinates, ordered by node index (flight order).
description.de: (englisch) Returns the waypoint polyline of one flight path as an array of world coordinates, ordered by node index (flight order).

description.en: Returns the node chain the client would actually fly to a taxi-map slot, as an array of TaxiNodes.dbc IDs in flight order ({ currentNodeID, …, destNodeID }). slotIndex is the legacy 1..NumTaxiNodes() index (the same one TaxiNodeName/TakeTaxiNode take). **Only meaningful while the taxi map is open.**
description.de: (englisch) Returns the node chain the client would actually fly to a taxi-map slot, as an array of TaxiNodes.dbc IDs in flight order ({ currentNodeID, …, destNodeID }). slotIndex is the legacy 1..NumTaxiNodes() index (the same one TaxiNodeName/TakeTaxiNode take). **Only meaningful while the taxi map is open.**

description.en: Returns the id of this one piece of art, or nil when the name is not known. The same positive and negative rule applies.
description.de: (englisch) Returns the id of this one piece of art, or nil when the name is not known. The same positive and negative rule applies.

description.en: Returns an array of every atlas name that is currently known, in alphabetical order. The list includes the names you registered yourself.
description.de: (englisch) Returns an array of every atlas name that is currently known, in alphabetical order. The list includes the names you registered yourself.

description.en: Returns true when the name is known and false when it is not. This agrees with GetAtlasInfo at all times. A name that exists always returns a table.
description.de: (englisch) Returns true when the name is known and false when it is not. This agrees with GetAtlasInfo at all times. A name that exists always returns a table.

description.en: Returns the id of the sheet that holds the atlas, or nil when the name is not known. A built-in atlas has a positive id. An atlas you add with C_Texture.RegisterAtlas gets a negative id, so the two kinds never collide.
description.de: (englisch) Returns the id of the sheet that holds the atlas, or nil when the name is not known. A built-in atlas has a positive id. An atlas you add with C_Texture.RegisterAtlas gets a negative id, so the two kinds never collide.

description.en: Returns a table that describes the atlas, or nil when the name is not known.
description.de: (englisch) Returns a table that describes the atlas, or nil when the name is not known.

description.en: A ClassicAPI extension. Adds an atlas name that points at your own art, so SetAtlas and atlas markup work with a sprite sheet you ship yourself.
description.de: (englisch) A ClassicAPI extension. Adds an atlas name that points at your own art, so SetAtlas and atlas markup work with a sprite sheet you ship yourself.

description.en: Returns a new CalendarTime offset from the input by the given number of days (or minutes). Negative deltas walk backwards. Out-of-range inputs (month=13, monthDay=32) normalize via the underlying _mkgmtime / gmtime round-trip.
description.de: (englisch) Returns a new CalendarTime offset from the input by the given number of days (or minutes). Negative deltas walk backwards. Out-of-range inputs (month=13, monthDay=32) normalize via the underlying _mkgmtime / gmtime round-trip.

description.en: ClassicAPI function (Time). Signature not documented yet.
description.de: ClassicAPI-Funktion (Time). Signatur noch nicht dokumentiert.

description.en: Returns -1 if lhs < rhs, 0 if equal, 1 if lhs > rhs. Compares by epoch conversion so denormalized inputs sort consistently.
description.de: (englisch) Returns -1 if lhs < rhs, 0 if equal, 1 if lhs > rhs. Compares by epoch conversion so denormalized inputs sort consistently.

description.en: Converts a Unix epoch (seconds since 1970-01-01 UTC) to a CalendarTime table. Pure gmtime; no engine state touched.
description.de: (englisch) Converts a Unix epoch (seconds since 1970-01-01 UTC) to a CalendarTime table. Pure gmtime; no engine state touched.

description.en: Returns the current calendar time.
description.de: Gibt die aktuelle Kalenderzeit zurück.

description.en: Returns seconds until the next server midnight (00:00:00 in server wall-clock time). Returns 0 if called before login.
description.de: (englisch) Returns seconds until the next server midnight (00:00:00 in server wall-clock time). Returns 0 if called before login.

description.en: Returns [GetServerTime()](#getservertime) offset by the server's timezone. The result is a display value, not an instant: formatting it shows the realm's clock digits. If the realm reports 14:30, this returns the epoch for 14:30 UTC, so date("!%H:%M", t) prints 14:30. Do not compare it against a real timestamp.
description.de: (englisch) Returns [GetServerTime()](#getservertime) offset by the server's timezone. The result is a display value, not an instant: formatting it shows the realm's clock digits. If the realm reports 14:30, this returns the epoch for 14:30 UTC, so date("!%H:%M", t) prints 14:30. Do not compare it against a real timestamp.

description.en: Returns the server time as Unix timestamp.
description.de: Gibt die Serverzeit als Unix-Zeitstempel zurück.

description.en: Returns the duration of the last frame.
description.de: Gibt die Dauer des letzten Frames zurück.

description.en: Returns the same value as [GetTime()](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/API_GetTime) — seconds on the engine's uptime clock — but **frame-stable**: every call within a single frame returns the identical value, refreshed once per frame. Same epoch as GetTime(), so the two are directly comparable.
description.de: (englisch) Returns the same value as [GetTime()](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/API_GetTime) — seconds on the engine's uptime clock — but **frame-stable**: every call within a single frame returns the identical value, refreshed once per frame. Same epoch as GetTime(), so the two are directly comparable.

description.en: Returns haveTotem, totemName, startTime, duration, icon, modRate, spellID for one of the four shaman totem slots (1 Fire, 2 Earth, 3 Water, 4 Air).
description.de: (englisch) Returns haveTotem, totemName, startTime, duration, icon, modRate, spellID for one of the four shaman totem slots (1 Fire, 2 Earth, 3 Water, 4 Air).

description.en: Returns the time, in whole seconds, until the totem in the slot expires. Returns 0 when the slot has no active totem. Slots: 1 Fire, 2 Earth, 3 Water, 4 Air.
description.de: (englisch) Returns the time, in whole seconds, until the totem in the slot expires. Returns 0 when the slot has no active totem. Slots: 1 Fire, 2 Earth, 3 Water, 4 Air.

description.en: Returns the full duration of the active totem in the slot, in whole seconds. Returns 0 when the slot has no active totem. This is the same value as the 4th return of GetTotemInfo. It is the companion to [GetTotemTimeLeft](#gettotemtimeleftslot).
description.de: (englisch) Returns the full duration of the active totem in the slot, in whole seconds. Returns 0 when the slot has no active totem. This is the same value as the 4th return of GetTotemInfo. It is the companion to [GetTotemTimeLeft](#gettotemtimeleftslot).

description.en: Targets your totem in the slot (1 Fire, 2 Earth, 3 Water, 4 Air).
description.de: (englisch) Targets your totem in the slot (1 Fire, 2 Earth, 3 Water, 4 Air).

description.en: Returns the number of tracking spells in your spellbook.
description.de: (englisch) Returns the number of tracking spells in your spellbook.

description.en: index starts at 1 and follows spellbook order. The function returns these five values, or nil if index is out of range:
description.de: (englisch) index starts at 1 and follows spellbook order. The function returns these five values, or nil if index is out of range:

description.en: Turns on the tracking spell at index. You select a tracker when you cast its spell. This function casts it. For an out-of-range index, it does nothing.
description.de: (englisch) Turns on the tracking spell at index. You select a tracker when you cast its spell. This function casts it. For an out-of-range index, it does nothing.

description.de: ClassicAPI-Funktion (TradeSkillUI). Signatur noch nicht dokumentiert.

description.de: ClassicAPI-Funktion (TradeSkillUI). Signatur noch nicht dokumentiert.

description.en: ClassicAPI function (TradeSkillUI). Signature not documented yet.
description.de: ClassicAPI-Funktion (TradeSkillUI). Signatur noch nicht dokumentiert.

description.en: Returns the description of the recipe in row index of the trade-skill window. The function fills in the values in the text, such as amounts and durations, as the spell tooltip does. Most recipes that make an item have no description. For these recipes, for a header row, and for an index outside the list, the function returns nil.
description.de: (englisch) Returns the description of the recipe in row index of the trade-skill window. The function fills in the values in the text, such as amounts and durations, as the spell tooltip does. Most recipes that make an item have no description. For these recipes, for a header row, and for an index outside the list, the function returns nil.

description.en: Returns the link for the recipe in row index of the trade-skill window. The link is an enchant: link to the recipe spell, so it carries the recipe's spell ID. GetTradeSkillItemLink links only the item that a recipe makes. The link text is <profession>: <recipe>. If the recipe has no profession for the player's race and class, the text is the recipe name only. A header row, or an index outside the list, returns nothing.
description.de: (englisch) Returns the link for the recipe in row index of the trade-skill window. The link is an enchant: link to the recipe spell, so it carries the recipe's spell ID. GetTradeSkillItemLink links only the item that a recipe makes. The link text is <profession>: <recipe>. If the recipe has no profession for the player's race and class, the text is the recipe name only. A header row, or an index outside the list, returns nothing.

description.en: When the trade-skill window shows a profession from a link, the function returns 1 and the name of the linked player. Otherwise, it returns nil and nil. If the client does not know the name, the second value is nil.
description.de: (englisch) When the trade-skill window shows a profession from a link, the function returns 1 and the name of the linked player. Otherwise, it returns nil and nil. If the client does not know the name, the second value is nil.

description.en: Returns the link to the item that the recipe in row index of the trainer window makes. Only a profession trainer gives a link. For other trainers, for a header row, for a recipe that makes no item, and for an index outside the list, the function returns nil.
description.de: (englisch) Returns the link to the item that the recipe in row index of the trainer window makes. Only a profession trainer gives a link. For other trainers, for a header row, for a recipe that makes no item, and for an index outside the list, the function returns nil.

description.en: Returns an array of rows, each shaped { baseTag = "FOO_COLOR", color = ColorMixin }, mirroring the function of the same name. The color field is a real ColorMixin instance (carries GetRGB, GenerateHexColorMarkup, etc.) — the DLL calls back into Lua's CreateColor(r,g,b,a) per row to construct it, so ColorMixin and CreateColor must already be defined when GetColors is called.
description.de: (englisch) Returns an array of rows, each shaped { baseTag = "FOO_COLOR", color = ColorMixin }, mirroring the function of the same name. The color field is a real ColorMixin instance (carries GetRGB, GenerateHexColorMarkup, etc.) — the DLL calls back into Lua's CreateColor(r,g,b,a) per row to construct it, so ColorMixin and CreateColor must already be defined when GetColors is called.

description.en: Returns true if you can put a raid target icon on the unit. Otherwise it returns false.
description.de: (englisch) Returns true if you can put a raid target icon on the unit. Otherwise it returns false.

description.en: Returns xPos, yPos, distance — the world position of the nearest creature with the given NPC (creature-template) ID, and its distance from the player in yards. Returns nothing (nil) when no matching creature is in range.
description.de: (englisch) Returns xPos, yPos, distance — the world position of the nearest creature with the given NPC (creature-template) ID, and its distance from the player in yards. Returns nothing (nil) when no matching creature is in range.

description.en: Returns currentSpeed, runSpeed, flightSpeed, swimSpeed — all four in yards/second. There is no flying, so flightSpeed is always 0.
description.de: (englisch) Returns currentSpeed, runSpeed, flightSpeed, swimSpeed — all four in yards/second. There is no flying, so flightSpeed is always 0.

description.en: Returns true when value is a unit token, and false when it is anything else, such as a character name.
description.de: (englisch) Returns true when value is a unit token, and false when it is anything else, such as a character name.

description.en: Sets texture to the cursor image that the mouse shows when it is over the unit. For example: the speak bubble for an NPC with gossip, the mail icon for a mailbox, or the attack sword for an enemy. When you are too far away, the image is the grey "Unable" form.
description.de: (englisch) Sets texture to the cursor image that the mouse shows when it is over the unit. For example: the speak bubble for an NPC with gossip, the mail icon for a mailbox, or the attack sword for an enemy. When you are too far away, the image is the grey "Unable" form.

description.en: Returns the English class token.
description.de: Gibt das englische Klassenkürzel zurück.

description.en: Returns the spell ID that summoned unit: the totem-drop spell for a totem, or the summon spell for a pet or guardian. Returns nil for an unresolved unit, and for a unit that no spell summoned (players and world creatures).
description.de: (englisch) Returns the spell ID that summoned unit: the totem-drop spell for a totem, or the summon spell for a pet or guardian. Returns nil for an unresolved unit, and for a unit that no spell summoned (players and world creatures).

description.en: Returns the numeric **CreatureFamily** id (the CreatureFamily.dbc row — 1 = Wolf, 2 = Cat, 3 = Spider, …) for a unit, or nil when it has no family (players, non-beast NPCs, unsynced NPCs).
description.de: (englisch) Returns the numeric **CreatureFamily** id (the CreatureFamily.dbc row — 1 = Wolf, 2 = Cat, 3 = Spider, …) for a unit, or nil when it has no family (players, non-beast NPCs, unsynced NPCs).

description.en: Returns the numeric **creature id** — the NPC / creature-template entry — for a unit, or nil. This is the unit-token twin of [C_CreatureInfo.GetCreatureID](#c_creatureinfogetcreatureidguid): it does C_CreatureInfo.GetCreatureID(UnitGUID(unit)) for you.
description.de: (englisch) Returns the numeric **creature id** — the NPC / creature-template entry — for a unit, or nil. This is the unit-token twin of [C_CreatureInfo.GetCreatureID](#c_creatureinfogetcreatureidguid): it does C_CreatureInfo.GetCreatureID(UnitGUID(unit)) for you.

description.en: Returns the numeric **CreatureType** id (the CreatureType.dbc row — 1 = Beast, 3 = Demon, 7 = Humanoid, …) for a unit, or nil when it has no resolvable type. The raw-id twin of UnitCreatureFamilyID.
description.de: (englisch) Returns the numeric **CreatureType** id (the CreatureType.dbc row — 1 = Beast, 3 = Demon, 7 = Humanoid, …) for a unit, or nil when it has no resolvable type. The raw-id twin of UnitCreatureFamilyID.

description.en: Returns (distanceSquared, checkedPosition) — the **squared** world distance (yards²) from the player to unit, and a flag indicating whether both positions were available.
description.de: (englisch) Returns (distanceSquared, checkedPosition) — the **squared** world distance (yards²) from the player to unit, and a flag indicating whether both positions were available.

description.en: Returns the GUID of a unit.
description.de: Gibt die GUID einer Einheit zurück.

description.en: ClassicAPI function (Unit). Signature not documented yet.
description.de: ClassicAPI-Funktion (Unit). Signatur noch nicht dokumentiert.

description.en: Returns missing health.
description.de: Gibt fehlende Lebenspunkte zurück.

description.en: Returns true if the player has clear line of sight to unit, false if world geometry (terrain or a building) blocks it, and nil when the check can't apply — an absent / unresolvable token, or a non-unit object. A ClassicAPI extension (not a stock WoW global).
description.de: (englisch) Returns true if the player has clear line of sight to unit, false if world geometry (terrain or a building) blocks it, and nil when the check can't apply — an absent / unresolvable token, or a non-unit object. A ClassicAPI extension (not a stock WoW global).

description.en: Returns whether the unit is in range.
description.de: Gibt zurück, ob die Einheit in Reichweite ist.

description.en: Returns whether the unit is AFK.
description.de: Gibt zurück, ob die Einheit AFK ist.

description.en: Returns whether the unit is DND.
description.de: Gibt zurück, ob die Einheit nicht gestört werden will.

description.en: Returns true if the unit is feigning death (Hunter's Feign Death).
description.de: (englisch) Returns true if the unit is feigning death (Hunter's Feign Death).

description.en: Returns 1 if the unit/character shares the player's guild, nil otherwise. Accepts either a unit token ("player", "target", "party1", etc.) or a literal character name ("Bob").
description.de: (englisch) Returns 1 if the unit/character shares the player's guild, nil otherwise. Accepts either a unit token ("player", "target", "party1", etc.) or a literal character name ("Bob").

description.en: Returns true if unit is a **minion of a player** — a pet, guardian, totem, or charmed creature — false otherwise. Primarily owner-based: the unit's owner GUID (SummonedBy / CreatedBy / CharmedBy) must resolve to a player, with "player-controlled but not itself a player" as a fallback. Owner-based is needed because summoned **guardians** (shown as "X's Minion") carry an owner but not the PLAYER_CONTROLLED flag, so a flag-only check would miss them. Players, NPCs, and world creatures return false.
description.de: (englisch) Returns true if unit is a **minion of a player** — a pet, guardian, totem, or charmed creature — false otherwise. Primarily owner-based: the unit's owner GUID (SummonedBy / CreatedBy / CharmedBy) must resolve to a player, with "player-controlled but not itself a player" as a fallback. Owner-based is needed because summoned **guardians** (shown as "X's Minion") carry an owner but not the PLAYER_CONTROLLED flag, so a flag-only check would miss them. Players, NPCs, and world creatures return false.

description.en: Returns true if unit is a minion (pet, guardian, totem, or charmed creature) whose owner is a player **other than you**, false otherwise. Owner-based: it reads the unit's owner GUID (SummonedBy / CreatedBy / CharmedBy), requires that owner to be a player, and requires it to differ from you. World creatures and players (no owner) return false; your own minions (owner is you) return false. A bad or unresolved unit token returns false.
description.de: (englisch) Returns true if unit is a minion (pet, guardian, totem, or charmed creature) whose owner is a player **other than you**, false otherwise. Owner-based: it reads the unit's owner GUID (SummonedBy / CreatedBy / CharmedBy), requires that owner to be a player, and requires it to differ from you. World creatures and players (no owner) return false; your own minions (owner is you) return false. A bad or unresolved unit token returns false.

description.en: Returns whether the unit is a pet.
description.de: Gibt zurück, ob die Einheit ein Tier ist.

description.en: Returns true if the unit is currently possessed (priest's Mind Control, warlock's Subjugate Demon). Reads UNIT_FIELD_FLAGS bit 24 (0x01000000) — the standard UNIT_FLAG_POSSESSED per emulator sources — directly off the unit's m_objectFields descriptor. Works for any unit token since UNIT_FIELD_FLAGS is broadcast in object updates.
description.de: (englisch) Returns true if the unit is currently possessed (priest's Mind Control, warlock's Subjugate Demon). Reads UNIT_FIELD_FLAGS bit 24 (0x01000000) — the standard UNIT_FLAG_POSSESSED per emulator sources — directly off the unit's m_objectFields descriptor. Works for any unit token since UNIT_FIELD_FLAGS is broadcast in object updates.

description.en: Returns the GUID string ("0x…") of the unit's owner — the summoner of a pet/guardian/totem, or the charmer of a charmed unit. nil for an unresolved unit and for anything with no owner (players, world creatures).
description.de: (englisch) Returns the GUID string ("0x…") of the unit's owner — the summoner of a pet/guardian/totem, or the charmer of a charmed unit. nil for an unresolved unit and for anything with no owner (players, world creatures).

description.en: Returns posY, posX, posZ, instanceID — the unit's world position, in the standard UnitPosition shape. nil when the unit has no known position.
description.de: (englisch) Returns posY, posX, posZ, instanceID — the unit's world position, in the standard UnitPosition shape. nil when the unit has no known position.

description.en: Returns the current power of a unit.
description.de: Gibt die aktuelle Ressource einer Einheit zurück.

description.en: Returns the maximum power of a unit.
description.de: Gibt die maximale Ressource einer Einheit zurück.

description.en: GetAuraDataBySlot returns the AuraData table for the aura that slot id slot names on unit. It returns nil when the slot id no longer names an aura. description.en: Searches unit's auras for one whose locale-resolved name matches spellName. If more than one aura matches, your own aura comes first. Case is not important: "inner fire" finds Inner Fire. Returns the AuraData for that slot or nil if not found. Without a filter, searches both ranges (helpful first, then harmful).
